method: Independent ASR of delivered MP3s, no authored-text prompt; punctuation/case/apostrophe and 20-to-twenty normalization only. Automated proxy, not human listening acceptance.

lines.speaker: Nia Pell
lines.authoredText: The photograph is on the shelf now. I can look at it without watching the door at the same time. Keep the words I agreed to. The rest of this room is mine.
lines.transcription: The photograph is on the shelf now. I can look at it without watching the door at the same time. Keep the words I agreed to. The rest of this room is mine.

lines.speaker: Nia Pell
lines.authoredText: I put the photograph on the shelf. I have not decided what I want to say about the night. Leave the recorder off. I need a room that can be quiet without becoming part of your story.
lines.transcription: I put the photograph on the shelf. I have not decided what I want to say about the night. Leave the recorder off. I need a room that can be quiet without becoming part of your story.

lines.speaker: Nia Pell
lines.authoredText: The nurse closed the door. Then someone outside called the room number. I stopped listening to the nurse. Whatever you can prove about the old order, do not call this room protected.
lines.transcription: The nurse closed the door. Then someone outside called the room number. I stopped listening to the nurse. Whatever you can prove about the old order, do not call this room protected. . . . . . .

lines.speaker: Nia Pell
lines.authoredText: I unpacked the photograph twice. I want this to be the last shelf I have to choose because somebody found the first one. You moved me again. You did not move the first room out of their records.
lines.transcription: I unpacked the photograph twice. I want this to be the last shelf I have to choose because somebody found the first one. You moved me again. You did not move the first room out of their records.

lines.speaker: Sister Lumen
lines.authoredText: The volunteer is still waiting for the shift you offered. Do not leave that work beside her bed.
lines.transcription: The volunteer is still waiting for the shift you offered. Do not leave that work beside her bed.

lines.speaker: Sister Lumen
lines.authoredText: The volunteer went home when you took the shift. That was your promise to keep, never hers.
lines.transcription: The volunteer went home when you took the shift. That was your promise to keep, never hers. . . . . . .

lines.speaker: Sister Lumen
lines.authoredText: I took the shift you promised. I was here when the volunteers went home. Next time, offer me the hours you mean to give.
lines.transcription: I took the shift you promised. I was here when the volunteers went home. Next time, offer me the hours you mean to give.
